warning.titlePre: Mercedes Vario 616D Timing Chain & Injector Seal Wear
paragraphs: Vario 616D engines — OM612 and OM647, across the entire W670 generation — commonly show timing chain/gear and injector seal wear. This is a confirmed pattern, shared with the equivalent-era Sprinter and well-documented in UK specialist workshops. We replace timing chains, timing gears, injector seals, and gaskets as standard on every 616D rebuild, regardless of which specific engine code your van has.

*include_in_hero_hook: yes — Source: established specialist pattern (per G-BRF), confirmed across the whole range via shared Sprinter-era pattern, per VRF-mercedes-vario.md. Applies to both OM612 and OM647.*
